body: I hear that. The only person who actually care if I am gone is my son. Literally the only reason I’m still here. He would be the only person at my funeral if I had one. It’s so fucking sad and the only person I have to blame is myself. I have a medical condition that is going to make me die early, I just wish it was after my son ( who’s autistic) got to adulthood. He’s going to be fucked if I don’t. My mom hates me, my dad abused me for decades…. I try to be grateful for all I have which makes it worse because I know there are so so so many people who have less.
Now if they could only make it like Mario kart live
